summary: Accurate on the whole, and its honesty sections are mostly fair. One headline number is not in the CLI's records (29 minutes to 4.6 seconds); the line on signing since 0.19.0 is wrong the other way. Two claims are too strong in sgit's favour (signatures name a clone; every index is checked against a signed commit), and the article undersells sgit: partial commits, one file with no clone on a normal vault, key rotation, mirror, policy carried by the vault, rewind detection and the secret guard. Almost everything on the 'Git is ahead' list can be built client-side; what cannot is what needs the host to read, and taking back data a reader has.

facts.notes: Checked against SGit-AI__CLI at 640069a: the source, sgit --help for every command group, CHANGELOG.md, the threat model and the response notes under team/humans/dinis_cruz/claude-code-web/10/. Numbers from the newsroom's briefs and cli.sgit.ai were marked external, not contradicted.

claims.notes: Two claims overstated in sgit's favour (TM-R01, TM-R42); several capabilities understated or missing.

findings.quote: On a 76,000-file vault, a one-file commit went from 1,739 seconds to 4.6.
findings.issue: The 29-minute figure is not in the CLI CHANGELOG or any note in the CLI repository. The 0.25.0 record has a one-file commit going from 4 min on the newsroom's 79,465-file vault, and 47 min for the first commit on the 228,000-file synthetic vault, to 9 s.
findings.evidence: SGit-AI__CLI at 640069a (branch claude/charming-babbage-5hzcxq, same code as dev), read 28 October 2026
findings.suggestion: Source it, or use the CLI record's figures.

findings.quote: though commits have been signed since 0.19.0
findings.issue: Commits were signed (ECDSA P-256, per clone key) long before October. 0.19.0 fixed the canonical signing input and added verification (check verify, fsck) and signatures-required on pull.
findings.evidence: SGit-AI__CLI at 640069a (branch claude/charming-babbage-5hzcxq, same code as dev), read 28 October 2026
findings.suggestion: Say signed for months, verified since 0.19.0.

findings.quote: The first status after upgrading to 0.25.0 took 18 minutes 23 seconds
findings.issue: It was the first status after a fresh clone (a 4.2 GB pack clone, nearly all of it disk wait), not after an upgrade.
findings.evidence: SGit-AI__CLI at 640069a (branch claude/charming-babbage-5hzcxq, same code as dev), read 28 October 2026
findings.suggestion: Say after a fresh clone on 0.25.0.

findings.quote: A fix on a branch, planned for 0.26.1
findings.issue: Since the CI change of 27 October, dev publishes it as the pre-release 0.26.1.dev0; it ships in the next release from main.
findings.evidence: SGit-AI__CLI at 640069a (branch claude/charming-babbage-5hzcxq, same code as dev), read 28 October 2026
findings.suggestion: Say on dev as 0.26.1.dev0, in the next release.

findings.quote: signed commits checked on every client
findings.issue: On every sgit client, and only when the vault turns on signatures-required. The web UI and old clients do not enforce it (TM-R26).
findings.evidence: SGit-AI__CLI at 640069a (branch claude/charming-babbage-5hzcxq, same code as dev), read 28 October 2026

findings.quote: The honest edge: sgit's host still sees sizes, timing and object counts, and in pack mode which commit each push carried.
findings.issue: The leak list is short: the host also sees tree equality (deterministic tree encryption), compressibility under blob-deflate, index pack sizes, which blobs share a folder in path-ordered packs, and which ranges a scoped clone reads.
findings.evidence: SGit-AI__CLI at 640069a (branch claude/charming-babbage-5hzcxq, same code as dev), read 28 October 2026

findings.quote: A read key is a capability, not a permission.
findings.issue: Reading is a capability; writing is a permission the host checks. A read-key holder with store write access can author history that check verify calls verified (TM-R01, the top accepted risk). A signature proves a key holder, not a particular clone.
findings.evidence: SGit-AI__CLI at 640069a (branch claude/charming-babbage-5hzcxq, same code as dev), read 28 October 2026
findings.suggestion: Add TM-R01 in one line, in the read-key bullet and the identity row.

findings.quote: are checked against the commit and its signature before use
findings.issue: An unsigned index is accepted unless the vault has signatures-required, and the snapshot index's flat member below the root is not checked by the reader (TM-R42).
findings.evidence: SGit-AI__CLI at 640069a (branch claude/charming-babbage-5hzcxq, same code as dev), read 28 October 2026
findings.suggestion: Say anchored to its commit and checked under the vault's signature policy.

findings.issue: Whole-file partial commits exist: sgit write <path> --file F [--also P:F] [--push] commits named files atomically to HEAD, leaving other edits uncommitted.
findings.evidence: SGit-AI__CLI at 640069a (branch claude/charming-babbage-5hzcxq, same code as dev), read 28 October 2026

findings.quote: Most of it needs a host that can read the content
findings.issue: Blame, bisect, search, IDE support and most of review are client-side in Git too and can be built; sgit already has history log --grep/--since/--until/--author/--file/--patch/--stat, history diff, show and reflog.
findings.evidence: SGit-AI__CLI at 640069a (branch claude/charming-babbage-5hzcxq, same code as dev), read 28 October 2026
findings.suggestion: Say which parts need a host that reads and which can be built.

findings.quote: a file is four plain GETs of fixed paths
findings.issue: Four only for a file at the root; one more per folder on the path. For paths declared with sgit cache add, one batch request.
findings.evidence: SGit-AI__CLI at 640069a (branch claude/charming-babbage-5hzcxq, same code as dev), read 28 October 2026

findings.quote: A pull of a 300-file pass on 228,000 files went from 566 to 31.7 seconds
findings.issue: Measured under cProfile, which inflates absolute times; the ratio stands. 31.7 to 16.9 s was a plain run.
findings.evidence: SGit-AI__CLI at 640069a (branch claude/charming-babbage-5hzcxq, same code as dev), read 28 October 2026

findings.quote: Encrypt a file to a person, inside the store.
findings.issue: The article misses several things Git has no equivalent for: vault mirror (custody without access), policy carried by the vault and enforced at clone and pull, rewind detection on every clone, the secret guard, write --push --json, serve and publish, and the cache layer. It also misses key rotation (rekey, move).
findings.evidence: SGit-AI__CLI at 640069a (branch claude/charming-babbage-5hzcxq, same code as dev), read 28 October 2026

findings.quote: sgit's cannot be revoked after the fact
findings.issue: Add the remedy sgit ships: vault rekey and vault move rotate the key going forward. Git and GitHub cannot revoke an existing clone either.
findings.evidence: SGit-AI__CLI at 640069a (branch claude/charming-babbage-5hzcxq, same code as dev), read 28 October 2026
